description: The signal vector of a node (architecture §3.12.2, implementation §10.1): what the point form of node_query closes with and node_review announces with, in data.signals, and what a floor-history row stores as its snapshot (architecture §3.12.3, §3.13.3). The validator applies it to data.signals wherever it appears. A signal without enough evidence is omitted, and the reader takes it as not evaluable.

n_observations.description: The closes in the quality window (architecture §3.12.1).

reopen_rate.description: Fraction of the window's tasks that did not close clean (architecture §3.12.2).

score.description: The quality score derived from reopen_rate (architecture §3.12.1).

margin.description: score − score_floor: the distance to the constraint (architecture §3.12.2).

cost_own_p50.description: Median of the node's own cost (architecture §3.12.2).

cost_own_p90.description: 90th percentile of the node's own cost (architecture §3.12.2).

cost_subtree_p50.description: Median of the cost of the subtree the node opened (architecture §3.12.2).

cost_subtree_p90.description: 90th percentile of the cost of the subtree the node opened (architecture §3.12.2).

cost_per_resolution_own.description: Own cost of the window's attempts over those that closed clean; omitted below min_observations clean closes (architecture §3.12.2).

cost_per_resolution_subtree.description: Subtree cost of the window's attempts over those that closed clean; omitted below min_observations clean closes (architecture §3.12.2).

avg_attempts.description: Mean final current_attempts of the subtasks the node requested (architecture §3.12.2).

spend_window.description: The node's accumulated own cost in the window (architecture §3.12.2).

duration_p50.description: Median of the node's duration, in milliseconds (architecture §3.12.2).

duration_p90.description: 90th percentile of the node's duration, in milliseconds (architecture §3.12.2).

tokens_in_p50.description: Median of the input tokens per task (architecture §3.12.2).

tokens_out_p50.description: Median of the output tokens per task (architecture §3.12.2).

requester_queries_per_task.description: Queries to requester the node opened per closed task (architecture §3.12.2).

egress_gates_per_task.description: Egress gates the node triggered per closed task (architecture §3.12.2).

reopen_rate_inner.description: reopen_rate over the inner group of the radial axis (architecture §3.12.2).

reopen_rate_outer.description: reopen_rate over the outer group, the fraction outer_share farthest from the node (architecture §3.12.2).

usage_share.description: Of the last usage_window assignments on the node's topic, the fraction it won (architecture §3.12.2).

idle_share.description: Of the same assignments, the fraction granted to another node while this one was free (architecture §3.12.2).

notice_provenance.description: The notices the node emitted within evidence_staleness (architecture §3.12.2).
